# complexforms.xml

complexforms.xml (and custom_complexforms.xml, see [Custom Data Files](Custom-Data-Files)) contains all of the information for Complex Forms.

# Structure

```xml
<chummer>
  <complexforms>
    <complexform />
  </complexforms>
</chummer>
```

[**complexform**](#complexform "complexform") nodes describe individual Complex Forms.

## <a id="complexform"></a>Complex Form Node

**id** (required): GUID. All ID fields are standard GUIDs, which can be generated by [external websites](https://www.guidgenerator.com) or plugins.

**name** (required): the name of the Complex Form.

**target** (optional): target description stored on the form, such as `Persona`, `Device`, or `File`.

**duration** (optional): duration code stored as text, such as `I`, `S`, or `P`.

**fv** (optional): Fading Value expression stored as text, such as `L-2`.

**useskill** (optional): skill used to thread the form when it is not the default complex-form skill.

**bonus** (optional): improvements granted when the form is learned. If the bonus selects a value, that value is stored as the form's extra text. When `bonus` is absent, an extra value passed in by the caller is stored instead. See [Improvement Manager](Improvement-Manager).

**source** / **page** (optional): book reference. See [books.xml](Books "books.xml").

**required** / **forbidden** (optional): selection rules evaluated by the shared requirements check. See [Conditions](Conditions).

**hide** / **ignoresourcedisabled** (optional): sourcebook-filter visibility. An empty `hide` element removes the form from filtered selection lists.

**notes** / **altnotes** / **notesColor** (optional): default notes text and highlight color. `altnotes` is preferred when both are present.
